purpose: Quantify literal q image/depth observations versus immutable associated-r surface teacher; not new native visibility labels or a training run.
original_teacher: V109 D/E/S/U at reference r and fixed nearest-r 3x3; retain every original state/quality/identity.
allowed_data: Only V109 exact TRAIN1000/8000 and its recorded 700frame depth/visible-mask/full-mask bindings after independent scope whitelist verification. No V113 mixed3200 or other source family follows.

fixed_math.continuous_bounds: 0<=x<W and0<=y<H, exactly V109; keep distinct from nearest-pixel validity and pixel-centre [0,W-1] convention.
fixed_math.ownership_authority: Complete official visible-mask owner set for source frame; owner count and bit mapping unchanged. Unique foreign at q is NOT native/associated-r E.
fixed_math.q_fields: Inbounds9,rawdepth9,depth_mm9,ownfull9,ownvis9,ownercount9,ownerbits9,positive/own/foreign/overlap/unassigned counts, centre ownership/depth, same-foreign9 flag. Keep mask-only and depth-positive own intersection distinct.
fixed_math.radius_is_constructed: q=r+fixed original<=4px source jitter, not production initializer error.

verification: Re-sample original r-nearest3x3 from pinned rawfiles and compare old NPZ raw/inbounds/ownfull/ownvis/count/bits/counts exactly. Recompute old labels with same classify helper using original geometry fields, centre rayZ and reference cameraZ; require all original labels and reasons unchanged. If mismatch, preserve failure and diagnose code/binding before continuing. No new GT-nearest match or threshold fit.
not_allowed: Copy q ownership into native D/E/S.
Turn missing mask/depth/background into external occlusion.
Replace associated-r D by E just because q centre lands elsewhere.
Use per-image GT pose/reference/ROI/mask as deployment feature.
Claim label mismatch or corruption solely from q-vs-r observation differences.
motivation_limit: Associated-r visibility may intentionally remain correct when small q jitter changes centre pixel ownership; crop may still contain the visible part. Diagnose feature/target contract, not automatically repair a supposed wrong label.
outputs: New original8000+q-observation JSONL/NPZ sidecar, old-state x q-owner tables, jitter<=3 subset and q-nearest-OOB counts. All denominators explicit; do not call observation categories classifier predictions or confusion of semantic D/E.
